question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death from aging?
premises: Non-eating by day is the means.
Death associated with age is named.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean approach or overcome death depending on context
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death from aging.
